# fvipers: seeds for the SCSP sound board's 68000 (m2sndrecomp --scsp).
# Addresses only, our own analysis (rules.md rule 7). The program dispatches
# through five tables of "jmp (d16,pc)" entries, 4 bytes each; every entry of
# each table is a seed: 0x601ab8-0x601af4 (16), 0x602a74-0x602bb4 (81),
# 0x60360e-0x60364a (16), 0x603660-0x60369c (16), 0x603de8-0x603e24 (16).
# Found from the 2,042 addresses MAME's 68000 executed in a 6,000-frame
# fight (M2TRACE_SNDPCS, patch 0004): 22 entries of these tables were the only
# seeds needed to recompile every one of them.
